acceptance: AC-001: Given a completed-task Change whose managed worktree is dirty, application list/detail and registered get_change report blocked readiness, checks not-run for that preflight, and no executable finalization; their captured basis fields match.

AC-002: Given a clean completed-task Change, show_finalization_context and displayed Finalize agree on candidate/readiness; editing the workspace after the read but before finalize_change causes managed validation to reject without a finalization receipt.

AC-003: Given a failed maintained check or preflight submitted through registered report_finalization_failure with current basis, restart returns its retained category, candidate and checks state while branch, claims, frontier stage and proof receipts remain unchanged.
AC-004: Given the same attempt key and payload twice, submission returns one record; changed payload, stale new basis or mismatched report sequence conflicts without overwriting current evidence.

AC-005: Given a newer candidate/contract, prior reports remain historical and cannot block that candidate; a same-head report alone cannot veto a currently eligible retry or clear an existing lifecycle guard.

AC-006: Given malformed frontier bytes for a known Change, registered MCP output, HTTP list/detail and Cockpit emit the tagged unavailable variant with no mutation action; unrelated entries remain visible and strict parsing still rejects the malformed bytes.

AC-007: Given interruption between report/pointer publication or an injected store write error, restart replays the bounded transaction or shows report-store-unavailable without changing product authority or claiming report success.

AC-008: Given unknown raw-summary, command, URL, log, environment or proof fields, or encoded report size above 16 KiB, validation rejects before persistence; stored fields follow the declared structured report contract.

AC-009: Given a finalizer with trusted context and failed preflight, its registered failure-report handoff retains an identity and says checks did not run; no checkout mutation, claim recovery, or successful finalization occurs.

AC-010: Given ready, blocked, unavailable, running, waiting and complete readiness fixtures, Cockpit renders the engine-selected action/explanation and labels copied prompts as copying, not agent launch.

AC-011: Given successful same-candidate finalization after a failed attempt, the success receipt is current and report history survives pointer retirement; retirement failure cannot replace successful status, and an ordinary read creates or retires no report.

AC-012: Given the P01/P02/P02-W/P03/P04 surfaces in this Design's Packet and Native Planning Scope section, routed core/adapter/HTTP/component checks and registered finalizer handoff pass; known-unavailable remains distinct from unknown Change.
AC-013: Given custody reporting with a changed workspace fingerprint or paths escaping/mismatching engine-observed dirt, reporting rejects without checkout edits or pointer advancement.
AC-014: Given 256 retained reports, the next new attempt returns diagnostic-capacity without deleting history; replay of an existing key returns its original record.

AC-015: Given a per-Change Git inspection timeout, missing workspace, or permission error during list/detail capture, readiness is unavailable with workspace-inspection-failed and no executable finalization; unrelated entries remain usable and mutation rechecks do not assume cleanliness.

AC-016: Given symlinked/non-directory report-root components or an escaped transaction target, report persistence rejects without touching an outside sentinel; authoritative portable snapshot export excludes host-local reports.

AC-017: Given the effective inspect-change prompt configuration, only read-only get_change and delivery_health are available; no terminal, edit, dispatch or Delivery mutation tools are exposed, and fixture outputs explain blockers without raw Git repair instructions.

acceptance_observations: P01-01 (AC-001, AC-002): Given clean and dirty completed-task fixtures, application list/detail/get_change/show_finalization_context from a common captured basis agree on candidate, readiness and executable action; dirty preflight is workspace-dirty with not-run checks and no executable finalization. A workspace edit between the read and finalize_change rejects without a finalization receipt.

P01-02 (AC-003, AC-005): Given a current-basis failed report then application restart, reads retain report identity, category, candidate and checks state while branch, claims, frontier stage and proof receipts remain unchanged; changed candidate/contract makes it historical, and same-head eligible retry retains its existing operation with Retry verification label without bypassing lifecycle guards.

P01-03 (AC-004, AC-014): Given identical attempt-key/payload replay, including after candidate change or a newer pointer, reporting returns the original record without moving that pointer; changed payload, stale new basis and wrong new sequence conflict. At 256 reports a new key returns diagnostic-capacity without deletion, while an existing key still replays.

P01-04 (AC-006): Given malformed canonical frontier bytes for a discovered Change, application list/detail/get_change return a tagged unavailable projection with nullable trusted basis and no mutation action; another Change remains readable, an unknown Change remains distinguishable, and canonical parsing still rejects those bytes.

P01-05 (AC-007): Given interruption between report and pointer publication, restart recovers the bounded RuntimeTransaction or returns report-store-unavailable; injected store errors produce no report-success claim and leave product authority unchanged. Missing storage means no prior report; corruption remains visible without byte deletion or hash repair.

P01-06 (AC-008, AC-013): Given undeclared free-form/proof fields, more than 16 KiB encoded report, overlong identifiers, more than 32 paths, changed custody fingerprint, escaped paths or paths absent from observed dirt, reporting rejects before report/pointer persistence and does not edit the checkout.

P01-07 (AC-011): Given failed reporting followed by same-candidate successful finalize_change, current success proof takes precedence and immutable report history survives matching-pointer retirement; injected retirement failure cannot replace success, finalization replay can reconcile, and ordinary reads neither create reports nor retire pointers.

P01-08 (AC-015): Given Git timeout, missing workspace or permission failure during required capture, the affected Change has unavailable readiness, workspace-inspection-failed, null workspace fingerprint and no executable finalization; trusted detail/proof survives, another entry remains usable, and mutation validation does not assume cleanliness. Workspace inspection is bounded, performed at most once per needed workspace per response, and skipped for actions not needing it.

P01-09 (AC-016): Given symlink/non-directory report-root components, unsafe file targets, symlink swap or escaped transaction participants, report storage/recovery rejects without changing an outside sentinel; portable snapshot export contains no host-local finalization reports.

P01-10 (AC-001, AC-005, AC-010): Given ready, running, waiting, blocked, unavailable and complete input states plus existing custody, request, dependency, review-repair and publication guards, the public readiness decision preserves the admitted precedence, uses existing operation/actor literals and safe engine explanations, and marks execution true only for a supported eligible operation.
constraints: Use the admitted Design sections Ownership and Snapshot Capture, Strict Public Read Contract, Readiness and Effect Rules, Finalization Diagnostic Report Contract, and Host-Local Report Persistence and Containment as binding semantics. Unknown basis values remain null; independently timed reads are not a global filesystem snapshot.

Preserve precedence: unavailable authority; active/uncertain operation wait or reconciliation; paused/terminal lifecycle controls; request/dependency action or wait; unobservable required workspace; failed workspace preflight; otherwise supported action. Apply existing review/custody/publication guards. A report alone neither vetoes retry nor clears a guard.

Report input binds contract/frontier digests, candidate/reviewed heads, expected diagnostic sequence and 1..128-character ASCII A-Za-z0-9._- attempt key. Categories are custody-preflight, maintained-check, independent-review; caller checks_state is not-run, failed or unknown. Use a fixed registered code enum, nullable engine-resolved check_id/exit_status, required observed fingerprint for custody, and at most 32 normalized contained relative paths matching observed dirt.

Reject undeclared raw summaries, commands, URLs, logs, environments, exception text, observer names, arbitrary artifact paths and successful-proof fields; engine supplies identity, timestamp, safe summary and non-authoritative producer. Enforce 16 KiB encoded report and 256-report per-Change bounds before persistence; no automatic eviction.

Read/report paths cannot modify product files, claims, frontier stage, acceptance or proof receipts. Previously recorded transaction recovery retains existing authority. Missing report store means no report; corrupt/unsafe/unwritable store yields report-store-unavailable without fallback paths or blessing bytes. No trustworthy custody report can be written from unavailable runtime or unobservable workspace.
